title: XOMA Royalty Corp 8-K Filing — 2026-04-27
summary: XOMA Royalty Corporation entered into a Merger Agreement with Ligand Pharmaceuticals Incorporated on April 27, 2026, pursuant to which Merger Sub will merge with and into HoldCo, with HoldCo surviving as a wholly owned subsidiary of Parent. Each common share will be converted into $39.00 cash plus contingent value rights, with the transaction subject to stockholder approval, antitrust clearance, and completion of a Holding Company Reorganization.
key_points: XOMA Royalty Corporation merged into Ligand Pharmaceuticals via a Holding Company Reorganization and subsequent merger
Common shareholders will receive $39.00 per share in cash plus contingent value rights (CVRs) representing interests in RemainCo LLC
Series A and Series B Preferred Stock will be redeemed according to their certificates of designation including accrued dividends
Series X Convertible Preferred Stock converts to merger consideration based on underlying share conversion ratio

Transaction conditions include: (i) stockholder approval by majority vote under Nevada law, (ii) Hart-Scott-Rodino antitrust clearance expiration/termination, and (iii) completion of Holding Company Reorganization and CVR Spin
Transaction has no financing condition attached to Parent and Merger Sub obligations
